Name: Farmers Store-Run Any Shop You Want
Author: bubuge12
Description:
[center][youtube]X8BRFsPMMU0[/youtube][/center]
[center][size=5][b][color=#e69138]Come build the store of your dreams![/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[size=5][color=#F5E6C8][b]cherr030 handled all the Korean translations and the amazing Korean page redraws:[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][color=#f5e6c8][size=5][b]https://blog.naver.com/tkfkdgi132/224362340292[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#00ff00][size=4]All interface buttons now include localized descriptions for every supported language, not just Chinese.[/size][/color]
pr-[url=https://gist.github.com/vinimar007]vinimar007[/url]
tr- [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194666622-waifuhtr/]waifuhtr[/url][/center]
[center][line]
[size=5][b]☕ [color=#00ff00]Support Farmer's Store[/color][/b][/size]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/bubuge][b][size=5]Support Farmer's Store on Ko-fi[/size][/b][/url]
[line]
[/center]
[center][color=#fff2cc][size=5][font=Arial]Order stock from suppliers, display your products, set your own prices, hire employees, and serve real customers.[/font][/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#fff2cc][size=4]Run a supermarket, restaurant, takeout shop, museum, or simply open a little store of your own.[/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#ff7700]Multiplayer is not currently supported, but it is expected to arrive soon.[/color][/center]
[line]
[center]
[size=5][color=#E6B566][b]🏪 Open Any Kind of Store You Want![/b][/color][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49651/49651-1784948031-1258159723.png[/img]

[color=#f9cb9c][size=4]Unlock a variety of specialty stores through business licenses. Each store can be upgraded from [b]Level 1 to Level 10[/b], with unique gameplay mechanics for every store type.

Licenses determine which specialty stores you can open, but [b]they do not restrict what you can sell[/b]. You can also combine stores to create more advanced businesses.[/size][/color]
[/center]

[line]
[center]
[size=5][color=#E6B566][b]👣 👣 Real Villagers. Real Customers.[/b][/color][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49651/49651-1784968983-306355892.png[/img]

[size=4][color=#ffe599]Villagers will leave their homes, walk to your store, browse your shelves, purchase your products, and leave reviews based on their shopping experience.

[/color][b][color=#ffe599]Your prices, product quality, employees, advertising, and store environment all matter.[/color][/b]
[/size][/center]
[line]
[center][size=5][color=#E6B566][b]
📦 Complete Store Management[/b][/color][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49651/49651-1784948018-239569038.png[/img]
[color=#ffe599][size=4]
Order products from different suppliers, stock your shelves, and decide how much each item should cost.

Hire residents of Pelican Town, assign their jobs and wages, provide staff meals, and do your best to keep them from regretting not working at Joja.[/size][/color]
[/center]

[line]
[center]
[size=5][color=#E98663][b]🍳 Cook. Serve. Survive.[/b][/color][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49651/49651-1784970909-1575393265.gif[/img]

[size=4][Wash, chop, cook, serve, and clean dirty dishes]

Build a fully functioning kitchen, create your own menu, prepare ingredients, cook every dish, serve your customers, and wash the dirty plates afterward.[/size]

[i][color=#ffe599]Customers remember everything, including the food you dropped on the floor.[/color][/i]
[/center]
[line]
[center]
[size=5][color=#9CCB8A][b]📸 Make Everything Worth Selling![/b][/color][/size]


[size=4]Take photos, create advertisements, and promote your business with more than [b]40 different posters[/b].

Special value tags reward the way you farm, fish, cook, explore, and fight.

[/size][b][size=4]Even a humble parsnip can become more valuable than Starfruit Wine.[/size][/b][/center]
[line]
[center][size=5][color=#8FC7E8][b]
🌎 Built for a Modded Stardew Valley[/b][/color][/size]
[left][/left]
[color=#ffe599][size=4]Compatible with major content expansions, including[/size][/color]
[size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Ridgeside Village[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Cornucopia[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]And many more![/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[line]
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49651/49651-1784947316-882718187.png[/img]

[size=6][color=#E98663][b][size=5]Come build the store of your dreams![/size][/b][/color][/size]

！🛒 🏪 🍳 📦 ⭐
[/center]
